query:
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.slug, s.description, s.provider_name, s.version, s.tags,
            (SELECT normalized_json FROM agent_card_snapshots acs
             WHERE acs.service_id = s.id ORDER BY acs.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as agent_card
        FROM services s
        WHERE s.visibility = 'public'::visibility
          AND s.status = 'active'::service_status
          AND ($1::text IS NULL OR s.name ILIKE $1 OR s.description ILIKE $1)
        ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
        LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
